decision: Selected the planar centroid (UTM 17N) of Allegheny County parcel 0497-B-00001-0000-00 (PIN 0497B00001000000), the parcel that the county address-point layer assigns to 35 Summit Park Dr, North Fayette Township, as the campus locator for DataBank's Summit Park Campus (PIT2).
layer: Allegheny County GIS 'OPENDATA/Parcels' map service layer 0 (Parcel; native NAD83 / Pennsylvania South ftUS, EPSG:2272), queried by PIN with outSR=4326 and again in its native CRS; Allegheny County 'Addressing/Addressing_AddressPoints' layer 0 for the address-to-parcel link

facts.centroid_method: planar centroid in EPSG:32617 (WGS84 / UTM 17N) of the ring returned with outSR=4326, transformed back to WGS84; geodesic area on the WGS84 ellipsoid; the native EPSG:2272 ring transformed locally with pyproj as a cross-check

identity_bridge: DataBank's Summit Park Campus and PIT2 pages give PIT2 at 35 Summit Park Dr, Pittsburgh, PA 15275, on a 17-acre campus with one data center (47,100 IT sq ft, 5 MW critical IT load) and room for two more.

Allegheny County's address-point layer has one active point for 35 Summit Park Dr (North Fayette Township, ZIP 15275) and assigns it PARCELID 0497B00001000000; the point lies inside that parcel, 108.7 m from its centroid.

The parcel polygon measures 17.22 geodesic acres (749,924 sq ft planar in EPSG:2272), matching the operator's 17-acre campus; the layer's CALCACREAGE attribute (28.86) disagrees with the polygon's own area and is not relied on.

consistency_checks.datum: WGS84 output requested from the service; the native EPSG:2272 ring transforms to a centroid 0.92 m away, so the residual reflects the service transformation, not source accuracy
consistency_checks.personal_data: The parcel layer carries no owner fields; no owner or personal data were requested or copied.
